Over Z_(3), the order2-invariant chain functor computes ordinary quotient homology and kills the odd 3-torsion, retaining 40 free H3 classes. This is exact finite computation from reconstructed input; comparison with a prior integral homotopy theorem supplies the torsion exponent.
